comment: Withheld variant of the proposed handover. H2 keeps its proposed rectangle x2|y2 but its exact terminal now carries a control total contradicting the value (control 99 != value 21); the existing build withholds H2 without rejecting the input. H2 sits inside the three-link chain group, so even with every member approved the whole group stays on the old books and no old record is reversed; the isolated H5 group still posts.
